instruction: PART 3: The word in capitals at the end of each of the following lines can be used to form a word that fits in the blank space in the sentences. Fill in each space in this way.

items.questionText: She placed the chairs ______ around the room to make sure everyone could see the screen clearly. (STRATEGIC)
The teacher's ______ of the math problem made it much easier for the students to understand. (SIMPLIFY)
The country has strict ______ policies to control the number of people moving there. (IMMIGRANT)

instruction: PART 4: This is an information gap activity. Student A explains all the words “down” to student B. Student B listens to the explanation and guesses the word and writes it down. The aim is to complete the crossword puzzle together.

instruction: PART 5: Take turns with your pair and ask the following questions to each other. Please make sure that you use the words in bold in your answer.
